news.title: Hurricanes host the Canadiens on 4-game win streak
news.ruTitle: «Харрикейнз» принимают «Канадиенс» с победной серией из 4 игр
news.description: Montreal Canadiens (13-5-4, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Carolina Hurricanes (16-3-2, in the Metropolitan Division)

news.title: Ducks visit the Avalanche following Gauthier's hat trick
news.description: Anaheim Ducks (11-10-1, in the Pacific Division) vs. Colorado Avalanche (12-7-3, in the Central Division)

news.title: Mammoth end 6-game slide with 4-1 win over Avalanche
news.ruTitle: Мамонт завершил серию из 6 игр победой над Эвеланш со счетом 4:1
news.description: — Vincent Trocheck scored a goal and assisted another to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Colorado Avalanche 4-1 on Wednesday night and snap a six-game losing streak.

news.title: Canadiens end power-play drought and hand Connor Hellebuyck his 1st Devils loss with 3-2 victory
news.ruTitle: «Канадиенс» преодолели засуху в большинстве и вручили Коннору Хеллебаку первое поражение от «Девилз» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Jake Evans scored the go-ahead goal, captain Nick Suzuki ended his team's long power-play drought and the Montreal Canadiens defeated the New Jersey Devils 3-2 on Wednesday night to halt a two-game skid.

news.title: Bruins beat Red Wings 4-1, spoil Detroit's Centennial celebration game
news.ruTitle: «Брюинз» обыграли «Ред Уингз» со счетом 4:1 и испортили игру в честь столетия Детройта
news.description: — David Pastrnak had a goal and an assist as the Boston Bruins beat Detroit 4-1 on Wednesday night and spoiled the Red Wings' Centennial celebration game.

news.title: Blackhawks star Connor Bedard awaiting test results on injured shoulder
news.ruTitle: Звезда «Блэкхокс» Коннор Бедард ждет результатов обследования травмированного плеча
news.description: Connor Bedard will undergo further imaging and consultation on his injured shoulder to determine a course of action, with sources telling ESPN that the Blackhawks captain may have a choice on whether surgery is needed and the timing.

news.title: Mammoth, Avalanche bring mountain style to Winter Classic uniforms
news.ruTitle: Mammoth и Avalanche привносят горный стиль в униформу Winter Classic
news.description: A mammoth crest anchors Utah's light blue jersey, while Colorado features a cream jersey with a burgundy "C" surrounding a mountain design.

news.title: Boston College to retire late Johnny Gaudreau's No. 13 jersey
news.ruTitle: Бостонский колледж снимет с производства футболку под номером 13 покойного Джонни Годро
news.description: The Boston College men's hockey team will retire the late Johnny Gaudreau's No. 13 on Feb. 12 ahead of its game against UConn at Kelley Rink.

news.title: Bruins bring 3-game losing streak into matchup with the Red Wings
news.ruTitle: «Брюинз» завершили матч с «Ред Уингз» трехматчевой проигрышной серией
